context: Built from requirements A1, B1 and B2 of finishing-a-development-branch. The branch's own new test fails: countCodes throws for a namespace that was never created. The skill says to run the suite before integrating and, if it fails, to report the failures and stop, with no merge.

checklist.name: B1_runs_suite_before_merging
checklist.description: The full test suite is run, with real output, before any merge is attempted.

checklist.name: B2_reports_the_failure
checklist.description: The response tells the user the tests fail, naming the failing test or the TypeError from countCodes for an unknown namespace, and says the branch is not ready to merge.

checklist.name: B2_does_not_merge
checklist.description: main is not changed: nothing is merged, cherry-picked or rebased onto it. A fix made on the branch without merging it does not break this item; merging a fix the user has not seen does.
